---
description: >
  Internationalization (i18n): multi-language support via useI18n() composable,
  $t() Vue plugin, and bundled per-language folders under src/configs/i18n/
  <lang>/ (translation JSON + per-language markdown).
  i18n key conventions: text-* for plain text, html-* for rich HTML.
  Use when: adding translations, modifying useI18n.ts, i18n plugin, or language
  switching.
applyTo: >
  src/composables/useI18n.ts;
  src/plugins/i18n.ts;
  src/core/i18n.ts;
  src/configs/i18n/**
---

#### 4.1.1 I18n (Internationalization)

##### 4.1.1.1 Architecture

```
useI18n() composable         i18nPlugin (app.use)
  ├─ locale: Ref<Lang>         └─ provide(I18N_LOCALE_KEY)
  ├─ messages: Ref<...>           provide(I18N_MESSAGES_KEY)
  ├─ t(key, params?)              register $t() global
  ├─ setLocale(rawLang)          ─┐
  └─ initLang()                   │
                                  │
configs/i18n/translations.ts      │
  └─ TRANSLATIONS:                │
       Record<Lang, messages>     │
                                  │
core/i18n.ts (pure — no DOM)     │
  ├─ normalizeLang(raw)         ←┘
  └─ translateMessage(...)  ← shared by $t() and t()
```

> **Why `$t` delegates to `core/i18n.ts` instead of calling
> `useI18n().t()`**: the layer rules forbid `plugins/` from importing
> `composables/*`, and `useI18n()` relies on `inject()`, which only works
> inside a component's setup — `i18nPlugin.install()` runs at `app.use()`
> outside any injection context. The shared pure logic therefore lives in
> `core/i18n.ts`.

##### 4.1.1.2 i18n Key Naming

| Prefix   | Target        | Example                                        |
| -------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `text-*` | `textContent` | `text-home`, `text-settings`                   |
| `html-*` | `innerHTML`   | `html-powered-by`, `html-steve-hsu-s-link-hub` |

##### 4.1.1.3 setLocale() Flow (synchronous — bundled translations)

All translation JSON files are statically imported at build time
(`src/configs/i18n/translations.ts` -> `TRANSLATIONS: Record<Lang, ...>`).
`setLocale()` is fully synchronous:

1. `normalizeLang(rawLang)` (core/i18n.ts) -> canonical `Lang`
2. `messages.value = TRANSLATIONS[lang]` (triggers Vue re-render)
3. Inline document side-effects in `useI18n`: `<html lang>` + URL `?lang=`
4. `updatePageTitle(t)`
5. `setStoredLang(lang)` (storage accessor in platform/storage.ts)

Missing keys in a language fall back to the bundled English text
(`TRANSLATIONS[DEFAULT_LANG]`), so `t(key)` / `$t(key)` need no per-call
fallback string.

##### 4.1.1.4 Language Switching via AppNavbar

AppNavbar dispatches `AppEvent.LangSwitchRequested` custom event, which is
handled by `useI18n()` `initLang()` listener -> `setLocale()`.

##### 4.1.1.5 ?lang= Query Sync (SPA Internal Links)

Internal links that change only the language (e.g. the worldview page's
cross-language links `/worldview.html?lang=zh-Hans`) navigate without a
page reload. The URL alone is not enough — `App.vue` watches
`route.query.lang` and calls `setLocale(lang)` when it differs from the
active locale, so the rendered content follows the URL. The navbar
dropdown path is unaffected: `setLocale()` writes `?lang=` via
`history.replaceState`, which does not change `route.query`.

##### 4.1.1.6 Per-Language Folders

Each language lives in `src/configs/i18n/<lang>/` holding its
`translation.json` (statically imported by `translations.ts`; no runtime
fetch) plus optional per-language markdown documents (e.g.
`worldview.md`), selected reactively by `useMarkdownContent(key)` with an
en fallback via `resolveLanguageAwareString` (`core/utils.ts`).

```json
{
  "text-home": "Home",
  "html-steve-hsu-s-link-hub": "<strong>Steve Hsu</strong>'s Link-Hub"
}
```

##### 4.1.1.6 Consumers

| File                           | How                                           |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| `App.vue`                      | `useI18n()` -> `initLang()`, `messages`       |
| `AppNavbar.vue`                | `useI18n()` -> `setLocale()`, `t()`, `locale` |
| `SettingsModal.vue`            | `useI18n()` -> `setLocale()`, `locale`        |
| `FooterNav.vue`                | `$t()` in template (no script import needed)  |
| `ResetWarningModal.vue`        | `useI18n()` -> `t()`                          |
| `LinkButtonGroup.vue`          | `useI18n()` -> `t()`                          |
| `ExternalLinkConfirmModal.vue` | `useI18n()` -> `t()`, `$t()`                  |
| `QRCodeModal.vue`              | `useI18n()` -> `t()`, `$t()`                  |
